Replies stream in with their reasoning, code blocks and tool calls. You
can a"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ttach photos and files, reference files with `@`, and run commands and skills with `/`.
- Press and "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"hold a message, a tool call or a file to see what else you can do with it. Copy
it, fix a message yo"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"u sent and send it again, or mention a file in your next message.
- Answer what the agent needs from"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" you: approve or reject a command, answer its questions, and
review a plan before it starts.
- Keep "},{"id":"p16s6","text":"an eye on long work. Goals, todo lists, queued messages, background jobs and subagents
each have the"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"ir own view, and you can pause, steer or stop them.
- Keep your sessions the way you like them. Drag"},{"id":"p16s8","text":" them into your own order, or group them by
project and fold the groups you are not using.
- Find th"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"ings with one search field that works the same everywhere: sessions, models, commands,
plugins, sche"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"duled tasks and workspace files.
- Get a notification when a turn finishes, a goal completes or gets"},{"id":"p16s11","text":" blocked, or the agent is
waiting for an answer. The connection stays up in the background.
- Browse"},{"id":"p16s12","text":" and preview the workspace files, and open a terminal on the harness computer.
- Open files full scr"},{"id":"p16s13","text":"een in Preview: CSV tables, JSON trees, notebooks, PDFs, pictures, video,
audio and archives, with f"},{"id":"p16s14","text":"ind in file. Save a copy puts any file on your phone.
- Manage the harness itself: models, agent pre"},{"id":"p16s15","text":"sets, plugins, scheduled tasks and archived
sessions.
- Make it yours. The Ink design comes in light"},{"id":"p16s16","text":" and dark, with accent presets or a colour of your
own, true black for OLED screens and a text size "},{"id":"p16s17","text":"you can change.
- Use the app in English, Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, French, Arabic, Bengali, Portugue"},{"id":"p16s18","text":"se,
Russian, Urdu or Thai. Right-to-left languages are supported."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The changelog lists what changed in each release."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Getting started"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### 1. Install the app"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Download the APK from the latest release
and install it. You need Android 8.0 or newer."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### 2. Make the harness reachable"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The harness only listens on its own computer by default. Pick the setup that matches where your
phon"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"s only listens on its own computer by default. Pick the setup that matches where your
phone will be."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"#### Same Wi-Fi as the computer"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Start the harness on the computer's local network address. On
harness 0.2.1-alpha.2 and newer:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Use your computer's real address instead of `192.168.1.20`. The harness prints a line like
`dsh web:"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" http://192.168.1.20:3080/?token=…`. In the app, choose **Local network**, paste that
whole link int"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"o the address field (or tap the paste button), and tap **Connect**. The token in the
link signs the "},{"id":"p26s4","text":"phone in, and the harness then appears under **Recent** for next time. Older harness
versions need a"},{"id":"p26s5","text":" small patch instead of `--host`; see `harness/README.md`."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"#### Away from home"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Install dsh-relay, a
harness plugin that adds a password, encryption and device pairing. Then choose"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" **Relay** in the
app and scan the pairing QR code. The Relay wiki page
walks through it."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"#### USB cable or emulator"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Run `dsh web` on the computer and `adb reverse tcp:3080 tcp:3080`. In
the app, choose **This phone**"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" and sign in with the link `dsh web` printed."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"#### On the phone itself"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The harness can run in Termux.
Choose **This phone**, and the app can start and stop the harness and"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" sign in for you. Setting up
Node in Termux does not work on every device yet; read `harness/TERMUX."},{"id":"p32s3","text":"or you. Setting up
Node in Termux does not work on every device yet; read `harness/TERMUX.md`
first."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"#### Your own HTTPS reverse proxy"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Paste its `https://` address in **Local network** mode. The proxy
encrypts the connection, but it do"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"es not check who is connecting. See
`harness/README.md`."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Read docs/SECURITY.md before you connect over a network. A signed-in phone can
do anything the agent"},{"id":"p36s2","text":" can do, and the agent runs commands on your computer. Treat signing in like
giving out shell access"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"can do, and the agent runs commands on your computer. Treat signing in like
giving out shell access."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- Local network mode checks the sign-in token but does not encrypt anything. Use it only on a
networ"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"k you trust.
- Relay mode adds encryption and a pinned certificate, and works from outside your netw"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"ork.
- Keep the `dsh web` link private. Anyone who has it can sign in until the harness restarts."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"DSH Mobile is tested against **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1**. Older harness versions back to
0.1.6 s"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"till work for the most part, but newer features need a newer harness. The
compatibility table lists "},{"id":"p39s3","text":"which app version goes with which harness."}],"truncated":true}
